title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
why_read: A concrete empirical comparison showing an old specialized CNN beats modern LLMs on a real diagnostic task is a genuinely useful reality check on AI hype.
analysis: This item reports that a convolutional neural network built a decade ago still outperforms current frontier large language models on skin cancer image diagnosis. That is a meaningful finding because it highlights how general-purpose multimodal LLMs, despite impressive language capabilities, are not automatically good at narrow, high-stakes visual classification tasks that specialized models were trained for. It's a useful counterpoint to inflated claims about LLMs replacing domain-specific models in medicine. The topic should interest engineers working on applied ML and those skeptical of benchmark hype.
